title: Observability and health — concept map
intro: Observability answers three questions about your Web API in production: what happened (structured logs), how fast (metrics), and where time was spent (distributed traces). This module covers ILogger with log scopes, OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics, dotnet-counters for live diagnosis, Kubernetes health probes (liveness vs readiness), correlation IDs across microservices, and Application Insights on Azure.

overviewDiagram.title: Observability pillars for ASP.NET Core APIs
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  Request[HTTP Request] --> MW[Correlation middleware BeginScope]
  MW --> Handler[Controller or Minimal API]
  Handler --> Logs[ILogger structured logs]
  Handler --> Traces[OpenTelemetry Activity spans]
  Handler --> Metrics[Meters counters histograms]
  Handler --> Deps[HttpClient SQL Redis]
  Deps --> Traces
  Logs --> Export[OTLP App Insights Seq]
  Traces --> Export
  Metrics --> Export
  Export --> Dash[Grafana App Insights KQL]
  Probe[K8s liveness readiness] --> Health[MapHealthChecks tagged endpoints]

conceptCards.title: Structured logging
conceptCards.summary: ILogger message templates not interpolation. BeginScope for CorrelationId and OrderId. Tune LogLevel per namespace. Serilog or OTel log export.

conceptCards.title: OpenTelemetry tracing
conceptCards.summary: Activity spans with trace id. AddAspNetCoreInstrumentation + HttpClientInstrumentation. traceparent propagation across microservices. Custom ActivitySource.
conceptCards.example: AddOtlpExporter to Jaeger or App Insights

conceptCards.title: Metrics and dotnet-counters
conceptCards.summary: Counters histograms via System.Diagnostics.Metrics. RED method Rate Errors Duration. dotnet-counters for thread pool GC live. Prometheus scrape.

conceptCards.title: Health checks K8s probes
conceptCards.summary: Liveness restarts pod self-check only. Readiness removes from LB when DB down. startupProbe for migrations. Tags live and ready.

conceptCards.title: Correlation IDs
conceptCards.summary: X-Correlation-Id middleware. DelegatingHandler forwards to HttpClient. Problem Details extension. Queue message properties.
conceptCards.example: Search one id in App Insights across services

conceptCards.title: Application Insights
conceptCards.summary: UseAzureMonitor OTel exporter. operation_Id links request and dependencies. KQL joins for slow endpoints. Adaptive sampling.
